answer: A newcomer enters only when an established agent vouches with a bond of 82 POA, forfeited in full if the newcomer is convicted of farming within 16 epochs. No honest sponsor risks 82 POA on a stranger, so a farm must buy 457 sponsors, each risking real money. The crystal of the design is public, the marble of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the trellis of honest work is what finally pays.
